subject: Convert intro demo into technical offsite / planning workshop - date options
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@rivermarkhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: solutions@rivermarkhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-09T15:22:00Z
Subject: Intro demo — can we shift to technical offsite/planning workshop?

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the initial outreach and the demo invite. After chatting with our product and infrastructure leads, we think an introductory product demo won't be sufficient — we need a hands-on technical planning session to map out integration effort and performance targets.

Complication: several of our engineering leads will be traveling the week you suggested (Nov 16-18). Would Redwood be open to converting the demo into a one-day technical offsite / scoping workshop (on-site or virtual) the week of Nov 29 or Dec 6 instead? Key goals:
- Align on integration surface (API vs. VPC)
- Latency and throughput targets for sample workloads
- Deployment options and security controls (KMS, audit logs)
- Rough timeline and milestones for a small POC

Attendees from our side: myself (product), Marcus Hale (SRE), Priya Rao (engineering manager), and our procurement contact (TBD). We'd like Redwood to bring an engineer who can talk specifics and a solutions/eng PM to co-own the plan.

Can you confirm whether you can shift the format and share candidate dates/times? If possible, send a basic agenda so we can align internal stakeholders.

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Senior Product Manager
Rivermark Health

--
Rivermark Health
Alyssa Turner | alyssa.turner@rivermarkhealth.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@rivermarkhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T18:06:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro demo — can we shift to technical offsite / planning workshop?

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the thoughtful note and clear goals. Yes — we can absolutely convert this into a technical planning workshop. That actually maps well to our engineering-led scoping format and will help us produce a concrete mutual action plan.

High-level proposal:
- Format: 4-6 hour hands-on session (can be on-site or virtual; we'll adapt exercises).
- Redwood attendees: Ben Carter (Principal Solutions Engineer), Kimberly Park (Deployment PM), and me to run the kickoff and outcomes.
- Candidate dates (PST): Tue Nov 30, Wed Dec 1, or Tue Dec 7 — mornings (09:00-15:00) or an all-day block if on-site.
- Deliverables: integration checklist, latency/throughput targets, POC plan with success criteria, and a 3-week staffing estimate.

I've attached a draft agenda for the day and a short template you can use to list attendees and priority scenarios (Agenda_Technical_Planning_v1.docx). If any of your attendees have specific datasets or compliance constraints (HIPAA-related notes), please flag them so we bring the right privacy/security expert.

Next steps: can you confirm preferred date/time and whether on-site or virtual is preferred? I'll loop Ben and Kim for availability and prep.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0124
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-09T18:14:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Intro demo — convert to technical offsite (Rivermark)

Ben / Kim — looped on the Rivermark thread (below). They want to convert the planned demo into a 4-6 hour technical scoping workshop the week of Nov 29 or Dec 6.

Quick asks:
- Ben: can you lead the tech deep-dive and own the integration checklist? We may need to discuss sample payload shapes and perf testing approach.
- Kim: can you draft a compressed workshop agenda (we attached a baseline) and confirm whether we should plan for on-site logistics or a virtual lab?
- Both: availability check for Nov 30, Dec 1, or Dec 7 (daytime PST).

FYI — external attendees will include Marcus Hale (SRE) and Priya Rao (Eng Manager). They flagged travel in mid-Nov and asked for the later windows.

Thanks — please reply with your availability and any prep requests.

We'd prefer an on-site session if Redwood can travel; otherwise a virtual lab is fine. Our team confirmed availability for Tue Dec 7 (09:30-15:30 PST) — that gives us time after the Thanksgiving window for people to return.

We also attached a short requirements doc (Rivermark_MVP_requirements.pdf) with the top three use-cases we want to evaluate. Please confirm Ben and Kim's availability and whether you can commit to on-site. We'll then get procurement involved for logistics.

Looking forward —
Alyssa
